name: dialogue-dash
description: Dash Express: gamified dialogue-writing practice (speech marks, punctuation, speech tags, reported speech, tense) on Cloudflare Workers + D1

scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:ui
scripts.db:init:local: wrangler d1 execute dialogue-dash --local --file=./schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute dialogue-dash --local --file=./seed.sql
scripts.db:init:remote: wrangler d1 execute dialogue-dash --remote --file=./schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute dialogue-dash --remote --file=./seed.sql
scripts.db:accounts:local: wrangler d1 execute dialogue-dash --local --file=./migrations/0004_teacher_accounts.sql && wrangler d1 execute dialogue-dash --local --file=./migrations/0005_class_owners.sql
scripts.db:accounts:remote: wrangler d1 execute dialogue-dash --remote --file=./migrations/0004_teacher_accounts.sql && wrangler d1 execute dialogue-dash --remote --file=./migrations/0005_class_owners.sql
scripts.test:server: node --test test/engine.test.mjs test/verbs.test.mjs test/seed.test.mjs test/modes.test.mjs test/seed-new.test.mjs test/payload.test.mjs test/express.test.mjs test/accounts.test.mjs test/ranks.test.mjs test/v17.test.mjs
